title: File abstraction layer port
when_to_use: File descriptors, metadata, directory iteration, symlinks, timestamps, truncation or file mapping must be rebuilt on POSIX.
boundary: Local POSIX filesystems. Async I/O, network filesystems, reparse points, ACLs and change notification are outside.
verification: short writes complete and interrupted writes retry
truncate and extend across large offsets
metadata matrix for file, directory, symlink, missing path and non-directory component
directory iteration terminates and returns usable entries
canonicalisation of existing and non-existing paths
